high_level_description: The image is a detailed infographic that highlights the groundbreaking achievement of Google mapping a piece of human brain with unprecedented detail. The top part of the image features a title in bold text: "Google has mapped a piece of human brain in the most detail ever." Below the title, there are two images side by side. The left image appears to be a microscopic view of a section of the human brain, showing various cells and structures in grayscale. The right image is a colorful, three-dimensional rendering of neurons and synapses, illustrating the intricate network within the brain.
